meaning: Let f be a first mover moved by none. Lambda.7's mover m moves something, is moved in no respect of change and cannot be otherwise in any respect of change; by the scope bridge it is moved in no respect and cannot be otherwise in any respect. So m is a first mover moved by none (this step reads Lambda.7's moving as an end as the case's MovesIn, DISAMB-MOTION), and by uniqueness f = m. If f were in potency in a respect r, it could fail to be r (potency of the contradictory), hence could be otherwise in r (bridge), which is excluded. So f is in potency in no respect.
